pin_diff.note: Functionally identical VIN pin (VIN vs IN).
Pin 4 differs (BYP/BYPASS vs NC/NC): safe only if PCB leaves Pin 4 floating or decoupled via 10 nF to GND; if PCB ties NC pin directly to GND/VIN, trace cut is mandatory.
Functionally identical VOUT pin (VOUT vs OUT).

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=0.47 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH PIN 4 (NC vs BYPASS/NR) CHECK: One device uses Pin 4 as an internal bandgap bypass/noise-reduction node while the other is NC. Verify Pin 4 is NOT tied to GND or VIN on the existing PCB before swapping; add a 10 nF bypass cap if low noise is required.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: TPS7A0533PDBVR is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 0.47 µF, p.6), whereas AP2210K-3.3TRG1 is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.025–15 Ω (p.22)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on AP2210K-3.3TRG1 can trigger control-loop oscillation.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 4.7x (AP2210K-3.3TRG1: 2.2 µF p.23 vs TPS7A0533PDBVR: 0.47 µF p.6); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: TPS7A0533PDBVR is rated to only 5.5 V rec. (6 V abs max, p.6) vs AP2210K-3.3TRG1 at 13.2 V rec. (15 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TPS7A0533PDBVR supplies up to 200 mA (p.6) compared to AP2210K-3.3TRG1 at 300 mA (p.1); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS7A0533PDBVR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6 V, p.6) than AP2210K-3.3TRG1 (15 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AP2210K-3.3TRG1 requires Vin,min >= 2.5 V (p.4) vs 1.4 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2210K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C ambient; -40°C to +125°C TJ) vs TPS7A0533PDBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2210K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP2210K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TPS7A0533PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Pin 4 NC vs BYPASS difference; ceramic output capacitor ESR stability difference; minimum output capacitance requirement differs 4.7x. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 51 °C on AP2210K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 200 °C/W) vs 47.3 °C on TPS7A0533PDBVR (θJA 185.6 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 100x ratio (100 µA (p.11) vs 1 µA (p.7)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2210K-3.3TRG1 "Pin 4 Is Active BYP (Internal Reference), NOT NC — CBYP Must Not Exceed 100 pF" (p.23) and TPS7A0533PDBVR "Cold-Temp (< 15°C) Ramp-Down Rate Trap Causes 130 ms Startup Delay or Glitch" (p.22). BOM decision: Choose AP2210K-3.3TRG1 when load current exceeds 200 mA (up to 300 mA) or input rails climb above 5.5 V (rated to 13.2 V); choose TPS7A0533PDBVR when battery sleep budget demands 1 µA Iq or your BOM standardizes on low-ESR MLCC ceramic output capacitors. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
